• View and cancel your bookings

Master.Welcome.other:
👋 Hello! I'll help you create a bot for online booking of your clients.

🎯 What you'll get:
• A personal bot with your name (@your_name_bot)
• Clients book themselves — you just confirm
• Calendar, services and prices — everything is customizable
• Notifications about new bookings right in Telegram

⏱ Setup takes 2 minutes.

📝 First step — create a bot in Telegram:

1. Open @BotFather (click the link)
2. Send the /newbot command
3. Enter a name (e.g. "Specialist John")
4. Enter a username (e.g. specialist_john_bot)
5. Copy the token — a long string of numbers and letters

Send me your bot token:

Master.Help.other:
🤖 This bot helps you create a booking bot for your clients.

Commands:
/start - Start creating a bot
/cancel - Cancel current operation

If you already have a bot, send /start to check status.

Master.Success.other:
🎉 Congratulations, %s!

Your bot @%s is ready.

🚀 What to do next:

1️⃣ Open @%s → send /start
2️⃣ Set up services and schedule
3️⃣ Send the link t.me/%s to your clients

Clients will be able to choose a time and book, and you'll receive a notification with "Confirm" or "Reject" buttons.

Good luck! 💪

Master.AlreadyRegistered.other:
✅ You already have a bot: @%s

Open it and send /start to use it.

Master.RegistrationFailed.other:
⚠️ Bot @%s was created, but message handling could not be started.

Try sending /start again — the system will try to reconnect the bot. If that doesn't help — contact support.
